body:
🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: YouTube's "Ready" badge and the detail's "Open existing" can disagree**

The list row shows the Ready badge when *any* preset of the destination already has a reusable copy (`presetsOf(d).some(...)`). The detail pane's `existing` (line 329) only looks at the preset that is selected right now (`presetForDestination(selected, probe, youtube)`). Example: a 4K YouTube copy exists, but the default for a 1080p source is 1440p. The row says "Ready", and clicking it shows a plain "Prepare for YouTube · ~N MB" button with no "Open existing". One fix is to compute the badge from the preset the row would actually make (`reusable[presetForDestination(d, probe, youtube)]`). The other is to switch `youtube` to the preset that already exists when the user picks the row.

🟡🧪 **Consider · tests: "Only when the copy fits" test never checks the negative case**

This test's name is "GitHub promises the 10 MB limit only when the copy fits it". It uses the 3:02 recording, whose Light estimate does not fit the 10 MB limit (`destinations.test.ts:114`). But it only checks that the "Small copy that plays inline" subtitle is shown. It never checks that "Under the 10 MB limit" is absent. If the conditional at `prepare-page.tsx:271` (`d === "github" && plan.underGithubFreeLimit`) regressed to always show the promise, this test would still pass, because `getByText` on the fallback subtitle succeeds either way only when the branch is correct. Add `expect(within(github).queryByText("Under the 10 MB limit")).toBeNull()` so the test covers what its name says.

🟡📝 **Consider · docs: "not merged yet" goes stale when this PR merges**

The new superseded note says Prepare lives "on `feature/niw2-578-prepare-screen` (not merged yet)". This note arrives in the same PR as the code, so once the PR merges the sentence is false: the recording page will already use Prepare on main. Consider removing the branch name and the parenthesis, or naming the PR instead. prepare-screen.md's status line already tracks merge state, so this note doesn't need to.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Obsolete: #458 (`cba9d254`) already computes the badge from the preset the row would make, `reusable[presetForDestination(d, probe, youtube)]`. That is the first fix suggested here. The code now lives in `pages/export/export-page.tsx:338`, after #467 renamed Prepare to Export, so the Ready badge and "Open existing" always look at the same preset.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Obsolete: #458 removed this test and #467 removed the conditional subtitle it covered. GitHub's limit is now a size-bar tag, tested on both sides in `pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:235` (the 3:02 recording reads "over GitHub's 10 MB free-plan limit") and `:245` (a 20 s recording reads "fits the 10 MB limit").

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`7a3aac00`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/7a3aac00ec8b9987055dada42021419946c33bcb) on #471 (top of the stack): export-presets.md no longer names the stack branch or says "not merged yet"; it says Share moved to the Export screen (first built as Prepare).
